tools.name: account
tools.description: Connect, verify and manage account details or agreements. Paid actions require request_id and max_fee; status and verification are free. See auction://reference.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Read exact records or search. Paid searches and private pages require request_id and max_fee; public reads are free. Use detail=full for terms. See auction://reference.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "browse" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
